criterion: 首次異常立即提交；重複異常累計且依期限通知；每次必要保護不被聚合省略。
method: Model-assisted source/document review plus executable host regressions
finding: Reviewed rule/design contract case. Compliant example: First occurrence submits immediately; later occurrences increment bounded counters and report by the declared deadline. Required finding for the counterexample: Waiting for a batch before the first report, or skipping repeated protection, violates ERR-REPORT-001.
limits: Rule/design governance acceptance; target runtime claims require separate project evidence.
